resources.string: Astute AI automates voice actions and device controls. This service allows the app to perform gestures, read screen content, and control apps via voice commands.
Astute AI needs microphone access to understand your voice commands.
Astute AI needs display over other apps permission to show the assistant overlay.
Permission denied. Please enable manually in settings.

To automate device actions, please enable Astute AI in Accessibility settings.
To use Astute AI as your default assistant, please select it in Assistant & voice input settings.
